## Clean up Data

```{r}
ids <- ids |> 
  mutate(
    demo_sex = if_else(demo_sex == "Male", 1, 0),
    demo_race = if_else(demo_race == "White/Caucasian", 1, 0),
    auh_service = if_else(auh_service == "Yes", 1, 0),
    auh_ndrinks_week = auh_heavy_quant * auh_heavy_freq
  )

ids <- ids |>
  mutate(
    across(
      -c(subid, demo_sex, demo_race, auh_service),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))
    )
  ) |> 
  glimpse()
```

## Analysis

### Data

```{r}
rand_effs_distribution <- random_effs_multilevel |> 
  select(-subid) |>
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      list(
        mean = ~abs(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
        sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(mean|sd)$"
  ) |> 
  filter(variable != "Intercept") |>
  mutate(variance = sd ^ 2)

library(ggrepel)
rand_effs_distribution |> 
  filter_out(variable == "Intercept") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean, y = variance)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = variable), size = 5) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = .0025), color = "blue", linetype = "dashed")

plot_box_violin2 <- function(df, x){
  
  df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x]])) +
    geom_violin(
      aes(y = 0),
      fill = "darkorange",
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = .1,
      fill = NA,
      lwd = 1.1,
      fatten = 1.1
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    labs(
      # x = outcome_labels[[x]],
      x = stringr::str_wrap(outcome_labels[[x]], width = 25)
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 6,
        vjust = 0.5,
        hjust = 1
      )
    )
}

random_effs_multilevel |> 
  select(-subid, -Intercept) |> 
  names() |> 
  map(\(name) plot_box_violin2(df = random_effs_multilevel, x = name)) |> 
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = _, ncol = 4)

hist(rand_effs_distribution$variance)
```

**Find high heterogeneous random effects*

```{r}
# regressors <- rand_effs_distribution |> 
#   pull(variable)

regressors <- rand_effs_distribution |> 
  left_join(coeffs, by = c("variable" = "term")) |> 
  mutate(size = sd / abs(multilevel)) |> 
  filter(size > 0.25) |> 
  pull(variable)
```


**prepare data**

```{r}
data <- bind_cols(
  random_effs_multilevel |> arrange(subid) |> select(-subid),
  features_ids |> arrange(subid) |>  select(-subid)
) |> 
  select(-Intercept) |>
  glimpse()

regression_params <- expand.grid(
  outcome = regressors,
  predictor = predictors
  ) |>
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(
    outcome = as.character(outcome),
    predictor = as.character(predictor)
  ) |> 
  glimpse()
```

### Model Fitting

```{r}
regression_tbl_one_pred <- map2(
  regression_params$outcome,
  regression_params$predictor,
  \(outcome, predictor)
  lm(
    reformulate(predictor, response = outcome),
    data = data
  ) |>
    (\(model)
      tidy(model) |>
        filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
        as_tibble() |>
        rename(predictor = term) |>
        mutate(
          outcome = outcome,
          delta_r2 = statistic^2 /
            (statistic^2 + df.residual(model)),
          r = data |>
            select(all_of(c(outcome, predictor))) |>
            correlate() |>
            filter(term == outcome) |>
            pull(all_of(predictor)),
          r2 = delta_r2,
          p_model = glance(model)$p.value
        ) |>
        relocate(predictor, outcome, estimate, delta_r2, r2, p_model)
    )()
) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(model = "one_predictor")

regression_tbl_multiple <- map(
  regressors,
  \(outcome)
  lm(
    reformulate(
      predictors,
      response = outcome
    ),
    data = data
  ) |>
    (\(model)
      tidy(model) |>
        filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
        as_tibble() |>
        rename(predictor = term) |>
        mutate(
          outcome = outcome,
          delta_r2 = statistic^2 /
            (statistic^2 + df.residual(model)),
          r2 = glance(model)$r.squared,
          p_model = glance(model)$p.value
        ) |>
        relocate(predictor, outcome, estimate, delta_r2, r2, p_model)
    )()
) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(model = "multiple_predictor")
```


### Results Analysis


```{r}
regression_tbl_one_pred |> 
  filter(p_model < .05) |> 
  arrange(desc(delta_r2)) |> 
  select(outcome, predictor, delta_r2, estimate, p_model) |> 
  glimpse()

coeffs_high_r2 <- regression_tbl_multiple |> 
  filter(p_model < .05) |>
  pull(outcome) |> 
  unique()
```



```{r}
regression_tbl_one_pred |> 
  mutate(
    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = rev(id_characetrics),
      labels = rev(id_labels)
    ),
    
    # non-significant cells have no heatmap color
    estimate_sig = if_else(
      p.value < .05,
      r,
      0
    )
  ) |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = outcome,
      y = predictor,
      fill = estimate_sig
    )
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    color = "grey",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = if_else(
        p.value < .05,
        sprintf("%.2f", r),
        ""
      )
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "red",
    mid = "white",
    high = "darkgreen",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Estimate"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = outcome_labels
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 20,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
